name: Webform 2Checkout
project_description:
Accept secure online payments from Drupal Webforms using the 2Checkout (Verifone) hosted payment gateway.

 Webform 2Checkout provides a simple and flexible way to add payment capabilities to Drupal Webforms without implementing a full eCommerce system or building custom payment integrations.

 Whether you are collecting donations, managing event registrations, accepting membership fees, processing applications, or building custom payment workflows, this module helps you connect Webform submissions with secure online payment processing.

 Modernized for Drupal 10 and Drupal 11 
 Webform 2Checkout has been completely modernized from its original Drupal 7 version to support the latest Drupal ecosystem.

 The new Drupal 10 and Drupal 11 compatible version has been rebuilt using the modern Webform Handler architecture and updated to work with the latest 2Checkout (Verifone) Hosted Checkout API.

 The upgrade improves compatibility, maintainability, and provides a cleaner integration approach while preserving the simple Webform-based payment experience.

 Simple and Secure Payment Workflow 
 Webform 2Checkout keeps the payment process straightforward:

 
 Visitors complete your Drupal Webform. 
 The 2Checkout handler prepares the payment request. 
 Customers are redirected to the secure 2Checkout hosted checkout page. 
 Payments are processed through the gateway environment. 
 Users return to your Drupal website after payment. 
 Payment details are validated and stored with the Webform submission. 
 
 Your Drupal website manages the form experience while 2Checkout handles secure payment processing.

 Key Features 
 
 Seamless integration with Drupal Webform 
 Supports latest 2Checkout (Verifone) Hosted Checkout API 
 No custom payment development required 
 Secure hosted checkout experience 
 Testing and Live payment modes 
 Flexible payment amount mapping 
 Configure different payment forms independently 
 Customer email mapping support 
 Multi-currency configuration 
 Checkout language configuration 
 Transaction reference tracking 
 Payment status management 
 Trigger Webform confirmation emails after successful payments 
 
 Ideal For 
 Webform 2Checkout is suitable for:

 
 Non-profit donation forms 
 Charity and fundraising campaigns 
 Event registration payments 
 Paid application forms 
 Course or training registrations 
 Service request payments 
 
 Quick Setup Overview 
 Getting started is simple:

 
 Add your 2Checkout merchant credentials. 
 Configure your payment settings. 
 Create your Drupal Webform. 
 Add the 2Checkout payment handler. 
 Map your amount and payment tracking fields. 
 Test your checkout flow. 
 Switch to Live mode and start accepting payments. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10 or Drupal 11 
 Webform module 
 
 Active 2Checkout (Verifone) merchant account

 Documentation 
 Complete setup instructions, payment handler configuration, field mapping examples, testing steps, and troubleshooting details are available in the README.md file included with this module.
